app.note:
New
- Ava Stage can update itself from GitHub Releases: Home shows one line, What's new lists the changes, and Ava checks size and fingerprint before you install.
Improved
- The Mac app leaves out development files, so the download holds only what Ava needs.
Fixed
- Download no longer stops at "Redirect was cancelled": Ava follows GitHub's download address and still checks every file.
